Evidence: site, schedule page, JSON-LD, robots.txt and GBP all inspected directly.

caveats: Review counts were not obtainable: the Google Maps pages my browser received were a limited view showing star ratings but never a review number. Ratings are recorded, counts are marked unknown rather than guessed.
Google web search from my browser was blocked by an 'unusual traffic' check, so ratings come from Google Maps directly and company details from company sites and search providers.

Several sites (East Coast, Elite Team, Land Quest, Title Hub, Inspection Guys, New Dawn) showed the same emoji in their tab/HTML title during my session; this looked like an artifact of my tooling rather than a real defect, so it is not counted against any business. East Coast's genuinely malformed/concatenated title is reported on its own evidence.

North Star's hero and a few Squarespace/WordPress sections rendered blank in my Chrome (scroll-reveal animations and a background video). The blank hero on North Star was reproduced at two widths and after waiting; treat the exact cause as unconfirmed.

North Star, Elite Team Title and Land Quest Title all list 214 Highway 18, 3rd Floor, East Brunswick, and Foundation Title and First Team share 197 Route 18 - inference: shared office suites / co-located title agencies on the Route 18 corridor, not affiliated companies as far as I could see.

Surety Title was excluded as a regional chain (18 offices) whose own locations page does not include an East Brunswick branch; the batch address appears closed but I did not find an explicit 'permanently closed' notice on a primary source.
data_gaps: Foundation Title: ftnj.com redirects to www.foundationtitle.com, which returned Cloudflare 522 (origin unreachable) on every attempt for ~15 minutes, so no page-level review of services, forms or schema was possible; its size and branch list come from the Google profile and search results only.
New Dawn Title: newdawntitle.com renders a blank white page over https and times out over http, so nothing about services, staff or ordering could be read; the firm's size is unknown.
No review counts or review text beyond snippets for any business; Google Maps limited view only exposed star ratings.
Surety Title: could not confirm the closed status of 197 Route 18 Suite 3000 from a primary source.

Inspection Guys: batch phone (800) 903-0670 differs from the website and Google profile ((732) 432-0220), and the site's JSON-LD carries a third number (732-484-2849); the correct primary number is unconfirmed.
